# PHP Ledger

> PHP Ledger is open-source, self-hosted double-entry accounting software for small businesses. It brings invoices, bills, payments, stock, reconciliation and reports together with reviewed payroll accruals, loan schedules and period/year-end workflows. Run it on PHP 8.2+ with MySQL 8.0.19+ (8.4 recommended) or MariaDB 10.4+. Use the browser installer, your own hosting and publisher-verified releases. Independent review and real-business acceptance remain separate gates.

Current stable release: 1.3.0. PHP 8.2+ (8.3 recommended), MySQL 8.0.19+ (8.4 recommended) or MariaDB 10.4+ (InnoDB), HTTPS; upload the phpledger folder and open it in a browser, no terminal required for setup; PHP zip extension for automatic updates.

New project-owned code: AGPL-3.0-or-later; commercial licensing available. Pre-adoption 0.1.0 through 0.1.5 previews retain MIT; dependencies and archived code keep their own terms.

## Implemented scope

- Company-scoped books, confidential user permissions, exact-money central posting, reviewed drafts, immutable journals and traceable dated reversals.
- Core invoices and bills, partial payments, credits, advances, refunds, historical ageing and control-account reconciliation.
- Account statements, trial balance, profit and loss, balance sheet, bank reconciliation and reviewed opening cutover.
- Optional purchasing, shared stock, multiple stock locations, transfers and a counter cash till over real inventory.
- Period-close checklist, cash counts, reversing journals and fiscal-year close, roll-forward and explicit reopen controls.
- Aggregate payroll accounting, staff advances and partial settlements, with a confidential employee register and explicit staff/driver links.
- Recurring and accrual schedules create reviewable journal drafts; loan schedules disclose their rate/day conventions and split principal from interest.
- Manual tax codes and dated rates, frozen currency snapshots, and source-linked ownership and related-party records.
- Scoped read-only API/MCP connections, audited plugin lifecycle and a private encrypted plugin secret store.
- Browser installation, installation-specific table prefixes and database TLS; Arabic draft translation with right-to-left layout.
- Optional CC0 sample packages with validated JSON payloads, explicit directory downloads and isolated practice-company onboarding.
- Publisher-verified application ZIPs and official GHCR/Docker Hub images built from the same ZIP; managed installations use matched backup and recovery.

## Outside the current workflows

- Payroll is aggregate accounting, not per-person pay runs, payslips, statutory calculation or filing.
- Loan conventions must be reviewed against the actual lender contract; automatic drafts still require review before posting.
- Country tax certification, statutory filing, full manufacturing, batches/serials/expiry and advanced industry workflows are outside this release.
- Financial write API/MCP, payment processing, bank feeds and offline use are not provided.
- Arabic is a draft translation pending native language and accounting review.
- Independent accounting/security review, supervised real-business pilots and restricted-host recovery qualification remain separate acceptance gates.
